title: AI Aapki Hi App Hack Karke Bug Dikhata Hai: 5 Open Source Tools | #Shorts
description:
Top 5 trending GitHub repos, Hindi mein - har number aaj check kiya gaya hai.

Is week ke top trending repos, 107k+ stars combined:

1. usestrix/strix (59k stars) - Open-source AI penetration testing tool to find and fix your app’s vulnerabilities.
2. projectdiscovery/nuclei (31k stars) - Nuclei is a fast, customizable vulnerability scanner powered by the global security community and built on a simple YAML-based DSL, enabling collaboration to tackle trending vulnerabilities on the internet. It helps you find vulnerabilities in your applications, APIs, networks, DNS, and cloud configurations.
3. 0x4m4/hexstrike-ai (11k stars) - HexStrike AI MCP Agents is an advanced MCP server that lets AI agents (Claude, GPT, Copilot, etc.) autonomously run 150+ cybersecurity tools for automated pentesting, vulnerability discovery, bug bounty automation, and security research. Seamlessly bridge LLMs with real-world offensive security capabilities.
4. GH05TCREW/pentestagent (3k stars) - PentestAgent is an AI agent framework for black-box security testing, supporting bug bounty, red-team, and penetration testing workflows.
5. Armur-Ai/Pentest-Swarm-AI (2k stars) - Autonomous penetration testing using a swarm of AI agents. Orchestrates recon, classification, exploitation, and reporting specialists with ReAct reasoning — supports bug bounty, continuous monitoring, and CTF modes. Built with Go, Claude API, and 7+ native security tools.

Comment karo "HACK" - saare links DM mein bhej dunga.
Kisi dev dost ko bhejo jise ye chahiye.
Save karlo, baad mein kaam aayega.
